purpose: Test sparse completed-session liquidity sweep/reclaim events whose timescale and reversal asymmetry may fit the 30-second lifecycle.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — Session Sweep Detector
source_basis.logic: Completed-session high/low becomes a fixed liquidity level; sweep means wick through followed by close back on original side; first qualifying outcome wins.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — Gold Session Map & Sweep Signals
source_basis.logic: Gold-specific Asian range is frozen, then London/overlap sweep and close-back-inside is treated as the signal.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — Asia Liquidity Sweep Reversal Scalper
source_basis.logic: Gold reversal entry after brief break of prior liquidity level followed by reclaim.

source_basis.source: MetaQuotes — Liquidity Sweep With MA Filter Tool
source_basis.logic: Reconstructible completed-bar sweep semantics distinguish simple wick-through from stricter reclaim/displacement confirmation.

configs.C01_ASIA00_06_LONDON07_12: Freeze 00:00-06:00 UTC high/low; during 07:00-12:00 UTC, first M1 wick through a level that closes back inside triggers reversal.
configs.C02_ASIA00_06_ACTIVE07_17: Same frozen 00:00-06:00 range, but watch 07:00-17:00 UTC; first event per side/day.
configs.C03_ASIA00_08_ACTIVE08_17: Freeze 00:00-08:00 UTC high/low; watch 08:00-17:00 UTC; first sweep-reclaim per side/day.
configs.C04_ASIA00_06_STRICT: As C01, but bullish sweep candle must close above prior M1 high / bearish below prior M1 low, matching the stricter displacement-style reclaim concept.
